chunks: And by this chain, from the servant of Ibrahim ibn Abda al-Nishapuri, who said: 'I was standing with Ibrahim on Safa when a youth came and stood over Ibrahim, and he took hold of his book of rituals and told him about some matters.'

key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدَةَ: Ibrahim ibn Abda, a prominent narrator
key_terms.الصَّفَا: Safa, a hill in Mecca associated with Hajj rituals
key_terms.مَنَاسِكِهِ: His rituals, specifically referring to the rites of Hajj

ai.seo_question: Who is the youth that met Ibrahim ibn Abda on Safa in the book of Ghaybah?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the concept of the Hidden Imam’s direct interaction with his companions during the Minor Occultation, specifically identifying the youth as a manifestation of Imam al-Mahdi (a.s.). The act of taking his *Kitab al-Manasik* (Book of Rituals) symbolizes the Imam’s ongoing guidance in religious jurisprudence, while the imparted knowledge underscores the continuity of spiritual authority despite physical absence.
